rows.en: (I can't... I can't run anymore......)

Who said you could take a break!?
\p!!
S-sorry!

(Just because the fighting with the Vajra's gotten
fierce lately, he didn't have to spring special
training on us out of nowhere...)
rows.notes: 'he' = Gary, who is running the training (subject restored).

rows.en: Worn out after just this much? That's pathetic.

You just have a pointless amount of stamina,
Yuuto.
rows.notes: 'Pointless' (muda ni) kept because Kagura's reply picks the word up.

rows.en:
'Pointless'? How rude.
It goes without saying that a pilot needs
stamina...

Then the answer here is obvious...
Let's get you full-body implants~!!

With this, you too can easily score
a body that never gets tired~~!!

Stop it, Hoshimura!
A sound mind won't dwell in a body like that!
It's by training like this, you see...

Sorry it's always so noisy,
\p-kun...
I don't think you need to apologize, Shirakawa...
(Ha ha, everyone really is the same as alw......)
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (interrupted by the emergency).

rows.en:
Listen up, you lot, it's an emergency!
Multiple defold reactions have been detected
in the space dead ahead of the Frontier fleet.
rows.notes: Matches the finished S.M.S. twin c24069.

rows.en:
It's a huge swarm of Vajra, several carrier-class
included! We're moving out right away too!
Roger!
